Questions
& answers.

When is the festival?

18 and 19 June 2027. Find performance times in the Schedule section.

Are tickets on sale?

Sales are not open yet. You can explore pass types, dates and quantities here.

What does my pass include?

A day pass covers the programme on your chosen date. A weekend pass covers both stages on 18 and 19 June.

Is any personal information stored?

Your pass selection stays on the open page only. No payment details are requested.
